statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-56741 is the CVE identifier for the JLine3 Telnet server (remote-telnet module) CPU-exhaustion DoS tracked as GHSA-2r2c-cx56-8933: TelnetIO.handleNAWS() accepts attacker-supplied NAWS terminal dimensions with only a lower bound and drives redisplay() up to 65534 iterations per event. Druid does not instantiate or expose a JLine Telnet server; jline is bundled as a transitive dependency (via the org.jline:jline uber-jar) for CLI line-reading only. The telnet server code is present in the uber-jar but is never loaded or executed in Druid's runtime. The fix exists only in jline 4.x (all 3.x versions are affected) and upgrading is a major version change incompatible with the current dependency tree.

CVE-2026-56740 is the CVE identifier for the JLine3 Telnet server (remote-telnet module) heap-exhaustion DoS tracked as GHSA-47qp-hqvx-6r3f: TelnetIO.readNEVariables() accumulates unbounded Telnet NEW-ENVIRON variable pairs, allowing an OutOfMemoryError. Druid does not instantiate or expose a JLine Telnet server; jline is bundled as a transitive dependency (via the org.jline:jline uber-jar) for CLI line-reading only. The telnet server code is present in the uber-jar but is never loaded or executed in Druid's runtime. The fix exists only in jline 4.x (all 3.x versions are affected) and upgrading is a major version change incompatible with the current dependency tree.

CVE-2026-56741 is a CPU-exhaustion DoS in JLine's remote-telnet server: TelnetIO.handleNAWS() accepts attacker-supplied NAWS terminal dimensions with only a lower bound and drives redisplay() up to 65534 iterations per event. This is the same defect tracked as GHSA-2r2c-cx56-8933. Data Prepper does not run a JLine telnet server. The upstream build pins org.jline:jline to 3.25.0 via a build.gradle dependency constraint ('because CVE-2023-50572'), purely as a transitive terminal/line-reader library; Data Prepper's own source references org.jline:jline-remote-telnet and the org.jline.builtins.telnet API in zero places (verified by code search across opensearch-project/data-prepper at tag 2.15.1). No source, sink, or processor plugin instantiates the Telnet server, the default shipped pipeline is random -> stdout, and the management server is com.sun.net.httpserver on port 4900 with http_basic auth. The vulnerable Telnet server code is never on an execute path in this image.

The vulnerable Telnet server code is never on an execute path in this image.
